metadata.short_desc: Recognize the same person across chat platforms.
metadata.desc: A cross-platform identity directory that merges accounts and group cards into one person, with a WebUI and an identity resolution API.

directory.title: Directory
directory.description: Manage contacts, platform accounts, and identity merges.

umo_filter_mode.hint: Blacklist mode allows sessions outside the list; whitelist mode allows only sessions in the list. Blacklist is the default. An empty list allows all sessions in blacklist mode and no sessions in whitelist mode.

umo_filter_list.hint: Enter the complete official AstrBot unified_msg_origin (UMO), for example aiocqhttp:GroupMessage:123456789; do not enter a user ID.

observe_messages.hint: Listen to message events and register the sender's platform account. Accounts are not auto-merged into existing contacts.

auto_track_display_names.hint: When a nickname or group card changes, record the new name in alias history for mention disambiguation.

auto_stub_person.hint: Create a standalone contact when an account first speaks. Merge contacts later in the management page.

capture_bots.hint: Also register other bot accounts into the directory.

inject_identity_context.hint: Temporarily add the canonical name and current display name to the LLM request. This is not written into session history.

allow_self_persona.hint: Allow members to view or update their own persona only in private chats. A persona may include linked accounts and long-term memories.

allow_member_lookup.hint: When disabled, only admins can search. When enabled, members can search only current-group contacts in the current platform instance, without account IDs.

hindsight_enabled.hint: Call the public Hindsight API directly using a stable person_id. This does not modify or depend on astrbot_plugin_hindsight_memory.

hindsight_recall_enabled.hint: Temporarily inject memories visible to this Person within the same audience scope.

hindsight_retain_enabled.hint: Write conversations that meet the minimum length and do not contain obvious credentials into the Person scope.

hindsight_cross_group_memory.hint: When off, group memory is recalled only within the same platform instance and group. When on, the same Person can recall memory across DMs, groups, and platforms.

hindsight_api_base.hint: From Docker, host.docker.internal:8899 is typical. On macOS host, prefer 127.0.0.1 to avoid localhost IPv6 issues.

hindsight_api_key.hint: Leave empty if local authentication is disabled.

hindsight_bank_id.hint: Bank ID used for Person memory reads and writes.

hindsight_recall_limit.hint: Maximum number of Person memories injected per request.

hindsight_item_max_chars.hint: Truncate each memory before injection to limit prompt size.

hindsight_retain_min_chars.hint: Messages shorter than this are not written to Person memory.

hindsight_timeout_seconds.hint: Skip recall or retain after this timeout. It should not block normal delivery.
